## Description

What this changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (a change that fixes an issue and breaks nothing)
- [ ] New feature (a change that adds something and breaks nothing)
- [ ] Breaking change (an upgrade needs action from the person running Keystone)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Dependencies or CI

## Testing

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint and tests)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated when behavior changes
- [ ] Tried in the browser with `npm run dev:fake`, if the page changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if needed (see [Keeping docs in sync](../CONTRIBUTING.md#keeping-docs-in-sync))
- [ ] Only placeholder addresses, host names and user names in code, tests and docs
- [ ] The title uses Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` and so on) and reads well in the release notes. See [RELEASING.md](../RELEASING.md).
